concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE polished square app icon concept for an independent fan-made Rudolstadt Festival companion app. The user explicitly wants an instantly recognizable connection to this specific festival, yet a distinct fan identity. Inputs are visual REFERENCES, not edit targets: image 1 official logo, image 2 official purple website graphic, image 3 official 2026 festival poster. Extract concrete identity cues: narrow tall gently irregular lowercase lettering; warm copper orange, aubergine purple and cream; the curved procession of separated tilted square dots. Use at most two of those as supporting cues and make a new dominant symbol. Flat print-like vector-friendly design with crisp silhouettes and restrained hand-cut character, very high legibility at 48px. Full-bleed square artwork, no rounded-corner outer frame (the operating system supplies its mask), no page, no captions, no mockup, no drop shadow outside the artwork, no tiny text, no dates, no 3D bevel, no fake glass effects, no generic music-note or headphones icon. Leave safe margin around the dominant symbol. This is a concept image, not a finished vector asset. CONCEPT 1 — dancing lowercase r. A large single cream lowercase r is the hero on a deep aubergine background. Design its tall narrow rounded stem and short softly rounded shoulder in the recognizable typographic spirit of the official lettering, but redraw it as an original compact, bold, slightly rising monogram. Not an uppercase R. Around the right side of the r, five or six generous copper-orange separated rotated square tiles form an asymmetric open dancing arc, recalling the festival's square-dot motif. One tile is gently displaced as a playful personal accent. Avoid making a near-copy of the full official logo; no other words. Think an instantly memorable independent companion emblem, strong graphic balance, lots of clean negative space. Only aubergine, cream, copper-orange.
